column1: # Rate constants for molecular radical-anion (X2-) reactions in alkaline-halide melts.
# Two reaction families are included here:
#   (a) Reaction (10) Me_2+ + X2-  ->  2 Me+ + 2 X-  (disproportionation route)
#       reported as k_10 in Table 4. In the paper the X2- decay follows
#       -d[X2-]/dt = k_10 [X2-]^2 (eq. 14) so k_10 is the bimolecular constant.
#   (b) Reaction (19) Cd+ + X2-  ->  Cd2+ + 2 X-  and analogues
#       (X2- with reduced cation of transition metal Me+)
# Units: k in dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1 (== M^-1 s^-1).
# T converted from degC to K (T_K = T_degC + 273.15).
# 2k/eps and the bimolecular 2k separately requested by the user: the paper
# reports k_10 directly (not 2k/eps); see notes column.
